title: pentacalia krukoffii
intro: Pentacalia krukoffii, commonly known as the "Maya tea plant", is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family that has been traditionally used for medicinal purposes. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as alleviating anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Pentacalia krukoffii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, but it is believed to have potential uses in the treatment of various conditions.
